decision.selected: One Bun-process modular workspace authority, existing WsRpcServer HTTP/WS adapters, jose verified auth, Bun.SQL Postgres transaction authority, existing native Projects surface/router. Only migrated Project operations enabled.
why: No extra web framework/ORM/broker is required for this slice.
Single database transaction can commit Project + principal/workspace membership when bootstrapped + idempotent receipt + minimal durable events.
Existing native channel map and RoutedClient provide the integration seam; replacing the entire workspace remote backend with Project-only host breaks unrelated surface channels.
WP-01 has no explicit dependencies; generalized registry/roles/command framework remain WP-02/03/04, not hidden prerequisite DAG edges.

authenticatedWorkspaceIds is refreshed from DB, never accepted from JWT custom scope, payload, handshake workspaceId or local profile. Handshake scope is requested scope requiring membership checks.

Store Actor on client; before command enforce expiry/session state, current membership/policy. Reconnect compares principal+issuer+session+scope and reauthorizes replay. Token renewal uses same issuer mechanism.

localIssuerRemedy.status: Root-owned proposed real local configuration, not existing or tested
localIssuerRemedy.when: No usable configured issuer can be discovered; authorized local work should continue without asking for an external account.
localIssuerRemedy.design: Same Bun composition may expose loopback local token/JWKS endpoints using existing jose and Bun.password. Persist per-account Argon2id credential hashes and issuer signing key; provision two separate account subjects server-side with root admin command; sign asymmetric audience-bound short-lived JWT. Store credentials with private permissions and secret handling, never print passwords/tokens or use hardcoded fixtures as auth.
localIssuerRemedy.schema: Root-owned 01-local-auth-bootstrap.sql applies after 01-domain-contract.sql, creates bootstrap_auth_credential (principal FK + actual account login identifier + Argon2id hash). Credential validation only authenticates issuer account; auth_subject_alias remains sole subject-to-principal resolver. Migration record identifiers use full filename/checksum.
localIssuerRemedy.limits: Authentic local multiuser acceptance may be claimed after exercising it. It proves neither external IdP federation nor cloud/public deployment. Private keys and provisioning outputs remain outside checkout.

policy.private: Membership plus ownerPrincipalId equality for read/list/create receipt access/write; outsider and non-owner member cannot see title, counts, slugs or paths. Agent allow-all is not ACL.
policy.members: Bootstrap owns owner-only private feature. Validate normative enum but return explicit CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE for members capability until accepted role policy exists. Do not silently reinterpret members as private or claim full API/parity coverage.
policy.workspaceBootstrap: An authenticated Actor may atomically create a previously nonexistent UUID workspace and membership with first Project; unique lock/insert handles race. For existing workspace require live DB membership; workspaceName is display data, never authority. Root admin may instead provision W1 + A membership, then command requires it. Existing identity never binds by workspaceName/email.
policy.queries: GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects and /projects/{projectId}, same ports in RPC. Return 403 generic denied for inaccessible workspace/resource; authorized empty list is distinguishable from errors, but unauthorized totals/cursors/titles never serialize. Cursor binds actor/workspace/policy epoch and stable (created_at,project_id).

transaction.database: PostgreSQL; Bun.SQL pool constructed only in composition root; transaction handle injected to repository. Parameterized queries; bigint revision serializes decimal string.
requiredConstraints: principal UUID primary; auth_subject_alias UNIQUE(issuer,subject) and principal FK; principal is global, not derived from local userId.

workspace UUID primary; workspace_member UNIQUE(workspace_id,principal_id), retained revocation/role state; project UNIQUE(workspace_id,project_id); FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id,owner_principal_id) REFERENCES workspace_member(workspace_id,principal_id). Live membership is rechecked under same workspace/member lock; revocation retains row and does not delete accepted Project writes.
schema_version > 0, revision >= 0, timestamps/tombstones retained; project canonical ID project:<UUID>; no FK to future registry.

project_create_receipt UNIQUE(workspace_id,actor_principal_id,idempotency_key), canonical normalized request hash, commandId/canonical Project UUID/revision/status/receipt bytes; key/hash conflict fails atomically.

Add minimal workspace_domain_outbox owned by bootstrap migration, immutable event_id unique, per-workspace monotone sequence assigned under workspace lock, aggregate_revision/policy_epoch/cause/correlation; no future framework dependencies.
algorithm: Strictly validate full envelope/payload before any write, compute canonical request hash including operation/workspace/target/schema/payload/expectedRevision but excluding random commandId/correlation and idempotency key.
BEGIN; resolve Actor, acquire workspace row/bootstrap lock and recheck membership/owner policy.

Reserve scoped receipt via unique insert/on conflict with transactional winner wait; compare stored hash. Same hash returns original canonical result after fresh access check; changed hash returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
Insert workspace/member only for explicit new-workspace bootstrap; insert Project revision 1, owner Actor, visibility private.
Insert project.created and workspace.member_joined only when membership was actually added, with eventId and cursor. Persist receipt/result in same transaction.
COMMIT before reply; verified response requires committed canonical read-back. Rollback any error leaves no partial rows/receipt/events.
transaction.migrationLifecycle: Root --migrate explicitly applies actual versioned 01-domain-contract.sql under Postgres advisory lock; schema_migrations records checksum/version. Fresh and repeated apply checked; checksum mismatch/readiness failure blocks write. Root-auth bootstrap additions use separate recorded migration or accepted additive extension. No fabricated generated timestamp.
transaction.recovery: Controlled process stop after COMMIT before reply; restart same persistent cluster/service; exact Actor/workspace/key/hash returns original ID/receipt/event rows. Changed payload under same key conflicts. DB crash after BEGIN rolls back all rows. Concurrent retries create exactly one Project and event sequence.

events.bootstrap: Transactional compact outbox row plus SQL replay/read cursor. Authorize current Actor/resource on replay and delivery. Existing ws ring buffer remains optimization only, never durability proof.
events.delivery: Per-workspace sequence order; read cursor and policy epoch; send references/revision invalidation only after commit, not title/list. UI refetch current authorized DTO; gaps trigger replay/refetch. Root may directly poll committed outbox for this vertical slice.
events.consumer: If client/server projection materialization is added now, effect+processed receipt+watermark must commit together with unique (consumer,event_id), implemented in this bootstrap repository. If no materialized projection exists, do not invent inbox success evidence.
events.laterWP04: Generic outbox leases/SKIP LOCKED dispatcher/inbox/retry-DLQ framework generalizes these accepted rows preserving event IDs, sequence, receipts; no duplicate publisher/store and no WP-04 prerequisite to private bootstrap.
events.control: Seeded dropped/duplicate/reordered event must fail observable replay/reload/revision convergence oracle. An event count alone cannot establish UI delivery.

transportAndSerialization.oneCommandGateway: Both HTTP and native domain RPC call the same commands.ts methods and repository ports with server Actor; old projects:create bridges to that one command. No global body Actor merging.
transportAndSerialization.nativeViewModel: Discriminated standalone LoadedProject or shared safe DTO; canonical ID can be route key/slug adapter with explicit origin, never spoof missing local folder paths. Shared detail disables unsupported tasks/assets/session injection/settings capabilities with typed errors; no file-authority escape.
transportAndSerialization.receipt: WP01 wire status + receiptId/commandId/requestHash/entity/observedRevision/verifiedAt plus canonical executionMode/lifecycle/verification. Persist serialized receipt then validate emitted HTTP/RPC result using same codec. applied requires live/succeeded/readback_verified and committed canonical entity/ref/revision/receipt.
transportAndSerialization.errorSemantics: 202 is a non-final canonical ambiguous/pending_fence command response when a receipt exists; never throw HTTP success without status triad. Terminal error body is code/safe message/retryable/correlationId, no title/subject/payload. RPC retains same code rather than HANDLER_ERROR downgrade; unknown internal errors sanitize to unavailable/generic.
transportAndSerialization.createRevision: Idempotency mandatory. expectedRevision required only for mutable existing aggregate; initial creation does not require invented revision. Envelope version and domain schema version separately validated.

nativeIntegration.selectedRoute: Extend existing RoutedClient Project authority routing in normal native mode; Project channels/subscriptions use configured authenticated workspace authority while existing local/remote route owns unmigrated kinds. Domain authority descriptor is explicit and root-owned. No second dispatcher or backend writer.
nativeIntegration.guard: Direct shared legacy write/asset/context lookup returns typed capability/authority denial; no fallback local file create after network failure. Configure shared objects separately from standalone; all title-bearing cache/push path rechecks current policy.
nativeIntegration.state: Scope key actor+workspace+authority epoch; cancel/generation fence stale refresh; purge previous list/detail/project atom before new fetch on actor/workspace change. loading, authorized empty, denied, offline unavailable, retryable error, unknown/reconciling, verified success distinct.
nativeIntegration.offline: Current PendingCommandsStore is owner approval decisions only and lacks typed domain envelope/idempotency/replay. Reuse/extend its canonical mechanism only through root-accepted typed namespace with durable command data and policy recheck; never reuse approval status as network status. Until root delivers that explicit extension, show unavailable/retained form draft and mark offline_queued acceptance missing. Persist service-committed unknown-reply reconciliation via receipt endpoint; no claim that an in-memory retry survives client restart.
nativeIntegration.scopeClaim: After live acceptance, label minimal private shared Project bootstrap verified; cross-surface registration/search/mentions/notifications/agent/sharing and members mode remain explicit uncovered package rows, not completed by bootstrap.
